subject: Updated High School Site Layout Recommendation
overview: The advisory team recommended an updated site plan to the School Building Committee that decentralizes parking and rotates the main athletic field to improve pedestrian safety. The meeting also covered the Breezeway pedestrian shortcut, athletic field configurations, and the placement of emergency assistance towers.

items.title: Parking Program and Site Layout Recommendation
items.summary: The team recommended an updated site layout to the School Building Committee that redistributes 477 parking spaces and rotates the rectangular field to improve sightlines and safety. Designers addressed concerns regarding traffic flow, bus priority, and the placement of solar canopies in the parking lots.

items.title: Athletic Field and Accessibility Design
items.summary: Designers reviewed plans for a synthetic turf field with an eight-lane straightaway, confirming that the Department of Conservation and Recreation allows support structures on the deed-restricted land. The team verified that all field access, seating, and parking will be fully ADA compliant, with distributed accessible spaces near all major entrances.

items.title: Pedestrian Breezeway and Specialized Entrances
items.summary: Architecture representatives introduced a 'Breezeway' outdoor pass-through at the second-floor level to provide a pedestrian shortcut and separate identity for the Curtis Tufts and preschool programs. The design utilizes sloped walkways to maintain accessibility while accommodating site topography.

items.title: Safety and Call for Assistance Stations
items.summary: The team identified locations for emergency 'Call for Assistance' blue-light towers and AEDs in parking lots and athletic fields to ensure communication with first responders in isolated areas. Members suggested adding a station near the pool and the trailhead for the Mustang Loop path.
